import os,re,numpy as np,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
I=np.array(G['Demo pair 3 input']); O=np.array(G['Demo pair 3 output'])
print('in:',[(i,j,I[i,j]) for i in range(10) for j in range(10) if I[i,j]])
print('out:',[(i,j,O[i,j]) for i in range(10) for j in range(10) if O[i,j]])

    for i,j,c in dots:
        best=min((abs(a-i)+abs(b-j),(a,b)) for a,b,v in dots if (a,b)!=(i,j))
        # nearest among originally distinct; also exclude cells of other dots as obstacles
        ai,aj,_=best
        d=abs(ai-i)+abs(aj-j)
        di,dj=ai-i,aj-j
        # direction: away from that dot? or toward? try both later; here TOWARD first
        si,sj = (1 if dj>0 else -1 if dj<0 else 0),(1 if di>0 else -1 if di<0 else 0)
        r,cc=i,j,k=0
        while k<d and 0<=r+h<h and 0<=cc+w<w and g[r][cc]==0:
            r+=si; cc+=sj; k+=1
            out[r][cc]=5
        out[max(0,min(h-1,r)),max(0,min(w-1,cc))] if False else None
        return out

def solve_manh(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    dots=[(i,j,g[i][j])]
    D=[(i,j) for i,j,c in dots]
    for (i,j,c) in [(a,b,v) for a,b,v in dots]:
        dists=[(abs(a-i)+abs(b-j),(a,b)) for a,b in D if (a,b)!=(i,j)]
        d,dot=min(dists)
        ai,aj=dot
        si,sj = 1 if aj>j else -1, 1 if ai>i else -1
        r,c=i+si,j+s; k=1
        while k<=d and 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and out[r][c]==0:
            out[r][c]=5; r+=si; c+=sj; k+=1
    return out

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]; D=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]]
    N=len(D)
    # connectors between aligned dots
    for idx,(i0,j0,c0) in enumerate(D):
        for idy,(a,b,c2) in enumerate(D):
            if (idx,idy)==(2,3) or c0==c2: continue
            if a!=i0 and b!=j0: continue
            step=1 if b>j0 else -1; col=j0+step
            while col!=b and 0<=col<w and out[a][col]==0:
                out[a][col]=5; col+=step
    # rays from each dot toward nearest dot: dominant axis; stop at edge/occupied; len = manhattan dist
    for idx,(i0,j0,c0) in enumerate(D):
        dists=[(abs(a-i0)+abs(b-j0),(a,b)) for x in range(N) if x!=idx]
        d,dot=min(dists)
        ai,aj=dot
        di,dj=ai-i0,aj-j0
        vdom = abs(di)>=abs(dj)
        k=1
        while k<=d:
            ni,nj=(i0+(1 if di>0 else (-1 if di<0 else 0))*k, j0+(1 if dj>0 else (-1 if dj<0 else 0))*k)
            if not(0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w) or out[ni][nj]!=0: break
            out[ni][nj]=5; k+=1
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,j,c in pts:
        others=[p for p in pts if p!=(i,j)]
        dr,dc=(0,1)  # default: no other dot -> toward top edge
        room={'N':(H-1-i),'S':i,'W':j,'E':W-1-j}
        if not others:
            dirs=[d for d,_ in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)) if True]
            cands=[(room[d],('N' if dr==-1 else 'S') ,dr,dc) for d,(dr,dc) in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)] if room[d]>0]
            (roommax,dn,drr,dcc)=max(cands,key=lambda t:t[0])
            dr,dc=drr,dcc
        else:
            near=min(others,key=lambda p:(abs(p[0]-i)+abs(p[1]-j)))
            dy,dx=near[0]-i,near[1]-j
            if abs(dy)>=abs(dx):
                dr=(dy>0)-(dy<0); dc=0
            else:
                dr=0; dc=(dx>0)-(dx<0)
        k=0
        while True:
            rr,cc=i+dr*k,j+dc*k
            if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W): break
            if g[rr][cc]!=0: break
            if out[rr][cc]==5: break
            out[rr][cc]=5; k+=1
            if k>(H+W): break
        # copy inline one past tip, overriding paint, if free & inside
        rr,cc=i+dr*(k+1),j+dc*(k+1)
        if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]==0:
            out[rr][cc]=c
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
